I am a chilean sociologist, currently a DPhil student in the "Information, Communication
and Social Sciences" programme at the [Oxford Internet Institute](https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk/),
University of Oxford. I am a Clarendon Scholar, and a member of Keble College. 

My research sits at the intersection of digital sociology and music studies, applying quantitative
and mixed methods to examine the impact of new technologies on the music industry and musician's
labour. I have worked as a research assitant on several projects concerning the impact of new 
technologies in labour, and studies of popular music

## Research interests

- Labour in the Cultural Industries under Platformization
- Popular music studies 
- Impact of new technologies in labour
- Quantitave approaches to the Sociology of Art
